summary: This is a pure documentation change (one new markdown report, 90 lines added, no code/config/workflow files touched), so it is correctly tier1 and carries no architectural or security surface; I independently spot-checked the report's key factual claims against live system state rather than trusting the self-report, and they hold up: the three new redispatched task directories (task-20260726-171337, -171405, -171420) genuinely exist on disk with real task.yaml checkpoint histories, one of them (the PR #80 write-gate merge-conflict fix) is already status: completed with a recorded real conflict resolution, passing test run, and push that lines up with PR #80 now showing state MERGED on GitHub; a live gitlink check (git ls-tree for mode 160000 on origin/master) also confirms row 9's claim of zero gitlink entries. No .github/workflows/** paths are touched, satisfying the hard rule, and no duplication concern arises since the report explicitly reasons through and dismisses the gateway's generic keyword-collision duplicate flags before dispatching only the 3 genuinely unmet tasks.
